title: Permission policy
description: `.ai/permissions/permissions.yaml`, the whole file, not a front-matter block. Deny is the default in two places and both are load-bearing: `defaults.mode` governs tools the file never mentions, and a tool entry without a `mode` is refused rather than assumed. That is invariant I3 in aicontext-core, and a schema that allowed a missing `mode` would describe a policy file the code would not honour.

version.description: Policy file format version, not the tool version.

tools.description: Per-capability modes, keyed by capability name. Every entry must carry its own mode.

scope.description: Path globs or argument patterns the grant is limited to. An empty list means the grant is not narrowed.

integrations.description: Where each integration's credential comes from. The NAME of a variable or keychain entry only; a value here is a leaked secret, which is CTX-016.
